performance.api_response_time_p99: 2,000ms — POST /v1/direct-debits must return 202 Accepted within 2 seconds for digital channel setups
performance.sca_completion_budget: < 30 seconds customer action budget for SCA step

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.95% — aligned with CAP-003 T2 availability floor. BACS DDI setup is time-insensitive (not a real-time payment) but customer expects digital channel responsiveness.
per_phase_nfrs.data_integrity: DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034) must be persisted before EVT-069 is published. Transactional outbox pattern required.
per_phase_nfrs.security: SCA required for digital channel DDI setup. FIDO2/WebAuthn or TOTP with session token validation via SVC-100.

performance.validation_completion: < 5 seconds for synchronous modulus check and account confirmation event round-trip
performance.auddis_submission_sla: AUDDIS 0N must be submitted to BACS within the same BACS processing window (T+0 of instruction receipt)

per_phase_nfrs.availability: Dependent on BACS/Vocalink AUDDIS service availability. Bank-side processing: 99.95%.
per_phase_nfrs.data_integrity: AUDDIS submission must be idempotent — duplicate submissions must be detected and rejected to prevent duplicate DDI creation.

performance.customer_notification_sla: Push notification dispatched within 1 business day of BACS confirmation receipt
performance.dd_guarantee_disclosure: Direct Debit Guarantee summary must be included in the activation notification — no exceptions

per_phase_nfrs.availability: SVC-053 (Notification Service) must deliver notification. Retry policy: 3 attempts over 30 minutes for failed delivery.
per_phase_nfrs.regulatory: DD Guarantee disclosure is mandatory under BACS scheme rules. Non-delivery of activation confirmation is a scheme compliance failure.

performance.file_processing_sla: BACS collection file processed within 2 hours of receipt from Vocalink
performance.advance_notice_timing: Customer advance notice notification dispatched within 1 hour of collection file processing

per_phase_nfrs.availability: BACS file processing is batch — SVC-009 must process files within the BACS D-2 window. Failure to process at D-2 is a scheme obligation breach.
per_phase_nfrs.data_integrity: DirectDebitCollection (ENT-035) must be created atomically with EVT-071 publication (transactional outbox pattern).

performance.account_debit_sla: Account debit (cross-capability SVC-001 processing) must complete within 4 hours of BACS D-0 settlement window opening
performance.event_driven_latency: EVT-072 or EVT-073 must be published within 5 minutes of AccountDebited or DirectDebitInsufficientFunds event receipt

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.95% — BACS D-0 processing is a scheme obligation. Unavailability during the BACS settlement window constitutes a scheme participation failure.
per_phase_nfrs.data_integrity: Account debit and DirectDebitCollection status update must be atomic. Idempotent on collection_id — duplicate debit signals must not result in double debit.

performance.indemnity_credit_sla: Account must be credited within 30 seconds of EVT-074 (DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled) publication. This is a regulatory obligation under the Direct Debit Guarantee ('immediate' refund).
performance.api_response_time_p99: POST /v1/direct-debits/{ddi_id}/indemnity-claim must return 202 Accepted within 2,000ms P99
performance.bacs_recovery_submission: BACS indemnity recovery instruction must be submitted to BACS within 2 working days of the claim

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.99% — indemnity claim handling is a regulatory obligation. Unavailability prevents the bank from meeting the DD Guarantee immediate credit requirement.
per_phase_nfrs.regulatory: DD Guarantee requires 'immediate' credit. The 30-second SLA is the operational definition of 'immediate' in this context — aligns with customer expectation of real-time banking.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All JRN-012 events on topic payments.direct-debit must be strictly ordered per account_id partition key. Out-of-order events (e.g. EVT-072 before EVT-071) must be detected and rejected by consumers.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: BACS lifecycle events have a defined sequence. Out-of-order processing would result in incorrect DirectDebitInstruction and DirectDebitCollection state transitions.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All SVC-009 event publishers and SVC-001 event consumers must implement idempotency on their respective entity IDs (ddi_id for ENT-034, collection_id for ENT-035, claim_id for indemnity claims). Duplicate events must not result in duplicate entity creation, duplicate debits, or duplicate credits.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: BACS file processing may produce duplicate messages in failure/retry scenarios. Idempotency is critical for financial integrity.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All six JRN-012 events (EVT-069 through EVT-074) must be routed to SVC-111 (WORM audit log). Retention: 7 years minimum per PRA regulatory requirements.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: BACS scheme rules and Consumer Duty require full lifecycle audit of DDI setup, collections, and indemnity claims.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All JRN-012 event payloads are classified as 'financial'. They must not include unnecessary PII beyond account_id and must never include full sort code + account number in event payloads visible outside SVC-009/SVC-001 (use account_id UUID internally).
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: UK GDPR data minimisation principle. account_id UUID is sufficient for cross-capability coordination.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: SVC-009 must maintain compliance with Pay.UK BACS Participation Rules for all AUDDIS and collection file processing. BACS processing windows and file format specifications (BACS Standard 18 for AUDDIS; BACS ARUDD) must be adhered to.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Pay.UK participation rules are a scheme obligation. Non-compliance may result in suspension from the BACS scheme.

regulatory_slas.requirement: Bank must credit the customer's account immediately on an indemnity claim under the DD Guarantee. No evidence or justification required from the customer.
regulatory_slas.operational_sla: Account credited within 30 seconds of EVT-074 publication
regulatory_slas.source: BACS Direct Debit Guarantee scheme rules

regulatory_slas.rule: Consumer Duty — Advance Notice of Variable Direct Debits
regulatory_slas.requirement: Customers should receive advance notice of upcoming collections, particularly for variable-amount Direct Debits, to allow them to ensure sufficient funds.
regulatory_slas.operational_sla: Advance notice notification dispatched within 1 hour of EVT-071 (D-2)

regulatory_slas.requirement: AUDDIS 0N (new DDI) and 0C (cancellation) instructions must be submitted within the BACS processing window (same T+0 business day of instruction receipt).
regulatory_slas.operational_sla: AUDDIS submission within BACS T+0 window
regulatory_slas.source: Pay.UK BACS Participation Rules — AUDDIS scheme

regulatory_slas.requirement: Originator collection files received at D-2 must be processed and validated within the BACS processing window. Late processing may result in D-0 debit failure.
regulatory_slas.operational_sla: Collection file processed within 2 hours of Vocalink delivery
